events.headline: Klarna brings flexible payments to Fresha, backing small businesses globally
events.summary: Klarna partnered with Fresha to bring payment choice to beauty and wellness businesses and their clients worldwide.

events.headline: Klarna and Kohl’s team up to bring flexible payment options to U.S. shoppers
events.summary: Klarna went live at Kohl’s online and in the Kohl’s app, giving U.S. customers access to its flexible payment options.

events.headline: easyShop rolls out Klarna across 19 European markets
events.summary: Klarna became available on easyShop across 19 European markets ahead of the marketplace’s first Black Friday and Christmas season.

events.headline: Klarna and Lands’ End expand partnership to Europe
events.summary: Klarna went live on Lands’ End sites in the UK, Germany, Austria and France, following a U.S. launch.

events.headline: Klarna partners with SQUIRE to bring flexible payments to barbershops nationwide
events.summary: Klarna partnered with SQUIRE to make flexible payments available through the barbershop-management platform.

events.headline: CarParts.com goes live with Klarna
events.summary: CarParts.com began offering Klarna’s full suite of payment options to U.S. customers buying automotive parts and accessories.

events.headline: Klarna’s flexible payment options become available at Adorama
events.summary: Klarna became available as a payment option on Adorama.com and related sites for photography, video, audio, drone and computer purchases.

events.headline: Klarna launches Consumer FX
events.summary: Consumer FX lets shoppers buy from participating Klarna merchants worldwide and pay in their own currency with no exchange fee.

events.headline: Klarna and FreshBooks partner for U.S. and Canadian small businesses
events.summary: Klarna partnered with FreshBooks to bring its payment options to small businesses and their customers in the U.S. and Canada.

events.headline: Klarna and Zoom expand to Canada
events.summary: The Klarna integration expanded to Zoom Workplace in Canada, enabling Canadian customers to use flexible payments for subscriptions.

events.headline: Klarna expands Fiserv partnership to enterprise merchants
events.summary: Klarna will be available on Fiserv’s Commerce Hub for merchants in the U.S., Canada, the UK and selected European markets, after going live at 100,000 U.S. Clover locations.

events.headline: Klarna launches on M&S.com
events.summary: Klarna became available on Marks & Spencer’s online store for Fashion, Home and Beauty purchases in the UK.

events.headline: TAP and Klarna expand flexible payments to four countries
events.summary: The TAP Air Portugal partnership expanded to the U.S., Spain, France and Italy, allowing travelers in those markets to book flights with Klarna.

events.headline: Ecommpay adds Klarna
events.summary: Ecommpay added Klarna to its payment choices so merchants can offer Klarna’s flexible payment options at checkout.

events.headline: Klarna partners with The White Company
events.summary: The partnership enables shoppers at the British home and lifestyle retailer to spread the cost of homeware purchases.

events.headline: Wayfair and Klarna deepen ties across the U.S. and Canada
events.summary: The expanded partnership added new flexible payment options, including always-on 0% APR financing for eligible U.S. customers.

events.headline: Klarna launches Care & Repair in the UK and France
events.summary: Care & Repair helps shoppers repair, alter and care for clothing and shoes rather than replace them.

events.headline: Klarna adds a free unlimited mobile plan for UK Max members
events.summary: UK Max members can sign up in the Klarna app for an unlimited mobile plan at no additional cost when switching an existing number.
